272.note_text: 1. An ancillary device is not necessarily subject to metrological control. 2. An ancillary device may be integrated in the gas meter.

270.note_text: device intended to perform a particular function, directly involved in elaborating, transmitting or displaying measurement results. The main ancillary devices are: a) repeating indicating device; b) printing device; c) memory device; and d) communication device
